summary: Makes DjangoLux client-side API URLs safe when dlux.urls is mounted outside project root. Base templates now inject the resolved Dlux mount prefix plus a Django-reversed endpoint map, and static JS helpers resolve preference writes, app-owned preferences, notifications, global search, session keepalive/logout/session-ended, and autofill API calls through those values instead of hardcoded /sys/, /accounts/, or /search/ paths. Inline-safe: no migration, context/template/static/docs/tests updates only.
highlights: Injects reversed URL metadata plus dluxUrl() and dluxEndpoint() for prefix-aware static JavaScript.
Rewires built-in preference, notification, search, session, and autofill calls away from hardcoded root paths.
Documents the downstream JavaScript rule: use {% url %}, dluxEndpoint(), or dluxUrl() for Dlux routes.
